scene.note: A wrong answer with no error is hunted down with a smaller log and printed values, mended, and guarded by an assert.

steps.note: The whole month goes in, and the report names the wrong hill.
One callout is taken out at a time, and each cut is kept while the answer is still wrong.
Each answer is compared with a count made by hand, until no callout can go and the answer stay wrong.
The smallest log that goes wrong goes in.
On each round, the names it works with are printed with their values.
The first value that is not what it should be points at the line to mend.
Now the report names the hill with the most callouts, and on a tie the first.
Its first line states what must be true of the log it is given.
A log with callouts passes the assert and is counted as before.
An empty log stops right at that line, with words that say why.
